INSERT INTO fin_std_cost (version_id, material_id, make, bom_id, material_cost, labor_cost, overhead_cost, unit_cost, std_hours, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.versionId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.make}, #{i.bomId}, #{i.materialCost}, #{i.laborCost}, #{i.overheadCost}, #{i.unitCost}, #{i.stdHours}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "bomId", material_id AS "materialId" FROM mes_bom WHERE is_default = 1 AND status = 1
SELECT bom_id AS "bomId", material_id AS "materialId", qty AS "qty", loss_rate AS "lossRate" FROM mes_bom_item WHERE bom_id IN #{id} ORDER BY bom_id, id

SELECT o.bom_id AS "bomId", o.seq AS "seq", o.name AS "name", w.name AS "workCenterName", o.std_hours AS "stdHours", COALESCE(w.labor_rate, 0) AS "laborRate", COALESCE(w.overhead_rate, 0) AS "overheadRate" FROM mes_bom_op o LEFT JOIN mes_work_center w ON w.id = o.work_center_id WHERE o.bom_id IN #{id} ORDER BY o.bom_id, o.seq

SELECT m.id AS "materialId", COALESCE((SELECT mc.unit_cost FROM fin_material_cost mc WHERE mc.material_id = m.id AND mc.unit_cost > 0 ORDER BY mc.period DESC LIMIT 1), m.ref_cost, 0) AS "price" FROM wms_material m WHERE m.id IN #{id}
